Name: CJB Item Spawner
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
[b]CJB Item Spawner[/b] lets you press [font=Courier New]i[/font] on your keyboard (configurable) to open a menu to spawn items:

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods/master/CJBItemSpawner/docs/screenshot.png[/img]

[b][color=#6aa84f][b][color=#6aa84f][b][color=#6aa84f]For non-English players, translations are included in the base mod. [url=https://github.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods#translating-the-mods]Contributions are welcome[/url]![/color][/b][/color][/b][/color][/b]

[size=6][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]For players on Android phones:[/b] install the [url=https://github.com/NRTnarathip/SDV-Mods/releases]Android version of the mod[/url] instead.


[size=6][b]How to use[/b][/size]
Load your save, then [b]press the letter [font=Courier New]i[/font] on your keyboard[/b] to show the item spawner menu. Change item quality by clicking the [b][☆][/b] quality button at the top.

To change the button, see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]key bindings[/url] on the wiki. (It covers Android too.)


[size=6][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/size]
If the menu doesn't open, see the pinned comment on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93/?tab=posts]the Posts tab[/url].


[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux, macOS, and Windows.[/*]
[*]Works in single-player and multiplayer. It can safely be installed by any player (host or farmhand), even if other players don't have it.[/*]
[*]No known mod conflicts.[/*]
[/list]

[b][size=6]Security[/size][/b]
This mod is fully [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Open_source]open-source[/url]. All its source code is public, so anyone can verify that it's not doing anything malicious.

Each release also has a [url=https://docs.github.com/en/actions/concepts/security/artifact-attestations]public attestation[/url], an unfalsifiable record which proves exactly how the release file was created. That lets anyone verify that it [i]only[/i] contains the public code, and hasn't been modified in any way.
